title: Delightful
text: The women who stood in line to make sure they acquired our tickets were delightful. Melissa our guide was a joy and full of interesting information. She made the tour fun and engaging. She was a great guide for our tour “family” as she called us.
author: Rhonda_H

title: The guide was phenomenal...
text: The guide was phenomenal and a true enhancement to the experience. We were in the city at the last minute and so we didn’t have an opportunity to buy a ticket in advance so this was our only option. But I highly recommend hiring a personal guide anyway.
author: Courtney_R

title: Melissa, Adriano and Fran are great!
text: Melissa did a wonderful job. The only weird thing is how you meet the line holder.  Who were all great. Handing someone your passport seems a little sketch but after the experience it is understandable. Seems like there would be a better way than having to have people spend the night outside to get you in queue. So, thanks Adriano!  Frans messages matched up and all went well!  Melissa was a ball of energy and fun!  I liked that she referred to our group as family. I would pick her to give us a tour again. Also, in items she did not know she was open with no ego as a learner herself.
author: Anthony_F

title: Alcazar tour Seville
text: I recommend booking a guided tour and avoiding queue for visit to Alcazar with Viator. We were welcomed by Jose who you meet in the morning while he buys your tickets. Melissa guided us on our tour. We really enjoyed our tour. Jose and Melissa were a pleasure to meet.
author: Noel_H

title: All  as advertised....
text: All  as advertised. Extremely knowledgeable guide. About 20 in the group. Booked relatively late. Operator was able to an on the day ticket. Process was well communicated by email and sms
author: Craig_F

title: The Alcazar is a must in...
text: The Alcazar is a must see in Seville for a reason, it's impressive and beautiful. Melissa, out guide, made the visit fun and informative.
author: Raluca_T

title: Royal Alcázar with Seville passion
text: A super-energetic tour by Melissa. We were really part of her "family". A real recommendation.
author: 496karst

title: Wonderful tour....
text:
Wonderful tour. Possibility to stay on site afterwards as long as you wish.
Thanks Rosa! 👍
author: Anne_P

title: Amazing
text: Absolutely AMAZING and was given great directions and communication to get there.
author: lisaaI4474FZ

title: I❤️Melisa
text: Melisa was absolutely amazing! She made our Royal Alcázar tour such a wonderful experience. She was engaging, funny, kind, and incredibly knowledgeable. She made the whole experience fun, memorable, and truly special. Melisa is honestly one of the best tour guides we’ve ever had! Highly recommend!
author: Javier_B
